A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Soft Reasoning work. Their complete main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B are readable and can be matched despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, neuron analyses, and computational measurements in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark accuracy, coverage, efficiency measurements, and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.2 and Appendix A retain the same first-token embedding perturbation, greedy decoding, verifier-plus-coherence objective, adaptive expected improvement, and random-projection optimisation. No algorithmic procedure or component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8K, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, StrategyQA, and AIME-2024. AIME-2024 already appears in v1 Table 12; no dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain CoT, Self-Consistency, FIRE, CoT-Decoding, and RAP. Appendix B.2/Table 9 also retains the same Prefix Scorer and Constrained Fine-tuning comparisons, already present in v1.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B.1 retain the same model configurations, zero-shot and 1/2/4/8-shot settings, 200 sampled examples per main benchmark, 300-token output limit, metrics, and baseline procedures.

E4.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 and Appendix B retain the same reward ablations, acquisition-function comparisons, token-count and placement tests, verifier comparisons, neuron activation and masking analyses, convergence analysis, and projection/sample-size sensitivity studies.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five runs with different random seeds and report means and standard deviations. Appendix B.4 retains the same experiment with 50 random projection matrices and its distribution plot. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–14, plotted results, and reported findings match. For example, Table 1 retains 79.4±1.2% zero-shot GSM8K accuracy for Soft Reasoning with LLaMA3-8B-Ins, and Table 12 retains 11.1±1.7% few-shot AIME-2024 accuracy. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, and derivations in Section 3 and Appendix A are unchanged, including Theorems A.1 and A.2 concerning regret and effective dimensionality.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about controlled exploration, reasoning accuracy, computational efficiency, model applicability, and verifier requirements. The new abstract sentence concerns code availability.

C2.justification: The interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including explanations involving critical neurons, multi-token instability, projection stability, unreliable verifier feedback, and limited interpretability of embedding perturbations.

D1.justification: v3's abstract newly states that the code is released and supplies a GitHub repository link, absent from v1. This adds implementation-access information; the documented optimisation details, experimental settings, and verifier prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works throughout the paper, and the reference list are unchanged. The positioning relative to decoding strategies, reasoning search, controlled generation, and Bayesian optimisation is retained.

P1.justification: The abstract gains a short code-release sentence, and the version/date annotation is updated. Existing prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organisation are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Reflow relocates existing material: Table 3 moves from page 7 to 8, Figure 6 from page 8 to 9, and Appendix A begins on page 14 instead of 13. All eight figures and fourteen tables retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The new code-release statement and repository link in v3's abstract improve access information for readers seeking the implementation. This is a limited benefit: the scientific content, evidence, and limitations are unchanged, and the supplied PDFs do not establish the repository's completeness or usability.
